description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer for detecting alias clashes in Orleans grain interfaces and related types. It includes logic for collecting type aliases, checking for duplicate method aliases, and reporting diagnostics when conflicts are found.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that detects alias clashes in Orleans grain interfaces and types.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, registers actions for syntax nodes and compilation end, and initializes alias map.

methods.name: CollectTypeAliases
methods.description: Collects type alias attributes from type declarations and adds them to the alias map.

methods.name: CheckMethodAliases
methods.description: Checks for duplicate method aliases within interface declarations and suggests renaming.

methods.name: ParsePrefixAndNumericSuffix
methods.description: Parses a string to separate a prefix and numeric suffix for alias renaming.

methods.name: GetNumericSuffixLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the numeric suffix at the end of a string.
